statement: The function returns a result r and r = min(c_odd, c_even), where c_odd is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(position) such that position[i] is odd, and c_even is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(position) such that position[i] is even.
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 0.
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 2 * r <= len(position).
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every integer t, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(position) such that position[i] and t have different parity is at least r.
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exists an integer t such that the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(position) such that position[i] and t have different parity is exactly r.
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if all entries position[i] have the same parity (all even or all odd).
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r on position and a result r' on other, r = r'.
preconditions: position satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(position) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), 1 <= position[i] <= 10^9. Also, other is any slice satisfying the same constraints with len(other) = len(position) and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(position), position[i] and other[i] have the same parity.
